Description: The revenue in the e-commerce market in Europe was modeled to amount to 673.82 billion U.S. dollars in 2025. Between 2017 and 2025, the revenue rose by 485.23 billion U.S. dollars, though the increase followed an uneven trajectory rather than a
consistent upward trend. The revenue will steadily rise over the period from 2025 to 2030, reflecting a clear upward trend.Further information about the methodology, more market segments, and metrics can be found on the dedicated Market [...] Read more
Note(s): Europe; 2017 to 2030
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

CHAPTER 02
User penetration

Description: According to a nationally representative survey conducted in 2023, eight in ten internet users in France purchased goods and services online in the previous 12 months. Out of the total population, this figure stood at 73 percent. After increasing sharply
in the last two decades, e-commerce penetration in France slowed down in 2023 compared to the previous year. Read more
Note(s): 2003 to 2023; 4,267 respondents; 12 years and older
Source(s): Agence du numérique; ARCEP; Conseil Général de l’Economie, de l’Industrie, de l'Energie et des Technologies; CRÉDOC

Main issues for e-commerce merchants in France in 2023
Share of respondents
0% 10% 20% 30% 40% 50% 60% 70% 80%

19 Description: In 2023, a survey revealed that the leading concerns impacting e-commerce merchants in France were the increase in transportation and delivery costs (76 percent) as well as the reduction in household consumption (75 percent). Another 72 percent of
surveyed online retailers cited supply chain disruptions as a major concern for their operations. Read more
Note(s): France; January 26 to February 22, 2023; 106 respondents; E-commerce directors and managers
Source(s): FEVAD; OpinionWay

Note(s): France; January 26 to February 22, 2023; 106 respondents; E-commerce directors and managers
Source(s): FEVAD; OpinionWay

Top factors driving e-commerce customer loyalty in France in 2023
Top drivers of e-commerce customer retention in France 2023
Share of respondents
0% 10% 20% 30% 40% 50% 60% 70%
Affordable prices 63.8%
Delivery conditions 45.6%
Offers and discounts by the brand 42.8%
Product quality 41.6%
29 Description: According to a survey conducted in March 2023, nearly two-thirds of French online shoppers cited affordable prices as the top factor encouraging them to buy again from a certain e-commerce retailer. Delivery conditions were also a main driver of
customer retention for around 45.6 percent of respondents. In the first quarter of 2023, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) was the e-commerce category with the highest customer retention rate in France, at 62 percent. Read more
Note(s): France; March 2023; 3,000*; *The sample size includes respondents from France, the UK, Spain, Italy, Germany and Australia. The source doesn't specify the sample size for France only, but the figures in this statistic refer only to France. Read more
Source(s): Comarketing-News; Packlink PRO; ShipStation
